articles.title: India, Oman strengthen defence cooperation through joint military training
articles.summary: India and Oman significantly strengthened their strategic defence partnership through a specialised military training initiative. Two Indian Mobile Training Teams (IMTT) conducted the program in Muscat, enhancing Omani personnel's capabilities. This collaboration deepens defence ties and mutual commitment to regional security, fostering greater interoperability between their armed forces.

articles.title: Tom Cruise's Days of Thunder co-star reveals his surprising last words before shocking crash on set
articles.summary: Cary Elwes, Tom Cruise's co-star from the 1990 action film 'Days of Thunder', recently lauded Cruise's profound dedication during its production. The film set was also where Cruise first met his future ex-wife, Nicole Kidman. Both actors, Cruise and Elwes, are currently 63 years old. This Hollywood anecdote highlights enduring professional relationships and behind-the-scenes insights from a classic film.

articles.title: Japan’s Task: Safeguarding Maritime Security in the Indo-Pacific
articles.summary: Japan is actively focused on safeguarding maritime security in the Indo-Pacific region. This critical task highlights its strategic role in maintaining a free and open international order. The nation's commitment is crucial for regional stability and economic prosperity, addressing evolving geopolitical challenges through naval presence and collaborative security efforts to ensure stability and economic prosperity in the vital maritime domain.

articles.title: Green Lantern: Every Human Who’s Had a Power Ring, Ranked By Power
articles.summary: Green Lantern stands as the premier sci-fi hero within the DC Multiverse. The Green Lantern Corps, a vast intergalactic police force, comprises thousands of diverse beings from across the universe. Their collective strength and adventures are fueled by immense willpower, uniting them in their mission across myriad worlds and dimensions, showcasing a rich tapestry of heroic narratives for readers.
